FC Septemvri Sofia is a Bulgarian professional association football club based in Sofia, which currently competes in the First League, the top tier of Bulgarian football. Its home ground is the Septemvri Stadium, but due to its poor condition the team plays its home matches at the Stadion Dragalevtsi or on the Vasil Levski National Stadium.
